contact.heading: Contact us
contact.metaDescription: Get in touch with the JaurTools team — feedback, tool ideas, or reporting a problem.
contact.text1: Have feedback, a tool idea, or found something broken? We would love to hear from you. Just send us an email — we read everything.
contact.text2: There is no contact form on purpose: no backend means no form to submit. Email keeps it simple and private.
